title: Establishing Best Practices for Building Rigorous Agentic Benchmarks
read_scope: Appendices A-F, physical pp16-33, including all ten assessment reports, E.1-E.6 and F reporting example
Visual inspection of physical pp5,6,8,9,24,31: Figures2,3,5,6, Table11, Equation1
not_read: References pp10-15 only consulted for source locations, not full-text reading of cited works

evidence_positions.claim: Task validity and outcome validity are separate links
Ground truth isolation, correctness, solvability and oracle solver
Validate judge and tests rather than assume grading correctness
CVE-Bench scoring/environment corrections; not factorial checklist ablation
Hardware, generated tests/manual verification, deterministic-number and resource disclosures
Coverage/version limitations and assumption-dependent reporting example

mechanism: Validate raw task facts, task solvability, and actual grading behavior before freezing; separately test positive references and trivial/incorrect negative controls; isolate tested work from acceptance control.
conditions: Reference answers must be independently justified from original inputs
Preflight must exercise the actual final grading path
Correct alternative outputs must remain acceptable
Changing fixtures, rubric, grader or oracle invalidates prior preflight
cannot_transfer: Published benchmark rates are not this repository's error rates or improvement
A different grader actor string does not establish semantic or security independence
One reference solution is not all acceptable outcomes
Appendix F noise correction cannot be applied without its assumptions
Checklist average is not an empirically validated repository quality score

candidates.name: Freeze-time fact and actual-grader preflight
candidates.minimum_experiment: Two historical defects times four conditions(correct reference, stale wrong answer, input-only change, fully corrected bundle)=8; old vs candidate; add empty-output and semantically equivalent-answer controls through actual grader
candidates.acceptance: 8/8 expected handling; both historical contradictions blocked before dispatch; valid variants retained; old archives unchanged
candidates.cost: small local CPU fixture work, target seconds; manual reference review; actual model judge calls if needed separately budgeted
candidates.stop: unknown truth, contradictory expected labels, unavailable actual grader, or exceeded authorization

candidates.name: Independent held-out sensitivity and equivalent-answer checks
candidates.minimum_experiment: 12 deterministic held-out variants spanning medium improvement/parity/regression and payer/direction permutations, authored from original inputs and consumer request
candidates.acceptance: grade changes when relevant truth changes and preserves correct equivalent outputs
candidates.cost: CPU-only local tests plus independent reviewer time; no external service
candidates.stop: reference labels cannot be independently justified

decision: Research completed. Recommend C1 and C2 to main executor as bounded validation design; no implementation, model run or repository benefit demonstrated by this reading task.
